note: G2 zombie AI (game balance, not real-world data). Zombies only pursue the closest hostile and strike it in melee: no weapon, no grenades, no cover. EN1: 'types' are the enemy types on the zombie brain and pack code; [0] is the plain zombie (unchanged), AI type 'Zombies + heavies' picks a type per slot by 'weight'. Per type: model (content/characters/<model>.glb, rest pose scaled to height_m; swap it here; its bones carry the game's joint names: Hips, Spine2, Neck, Head, Left/RightArm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot), fallback_scale / fallback_lean_deg (used on the zombie model and clips when the model or its walk clip is missing), scale (drawn and hit at that size; the physics capsule stays the soldier's), lean_deg (forward tilt), tint, hp, damage per blow, reach_m (the blow lands within it), lunge_m (a strike may start this far out and closes the gap during the wind-up), cooldown_s, attack_rate (the attack clip plays at this rate; the blow lands at its swing frame, windup_s is the fallback without clips), walk_mps / run_mps (run when the target is within run_within_m), weight (share in a horde), hit_zone_scale (hit capsule radii x, on top of the body size scale x height_m / 1.85: the spider is low, so its zones are widened), knockback_mps (shove on the player), stagger_min_damage / stagger_s (only a single hit of at least this flinches it and stops it that long), clips. The zombie's run_mps sits between the jog and the sprint of content/settings/movement.json. The model is content/characters/zombie.glb (RINONO, CC-BY-4.0, docs/credits.md). Brute = content/characters/troll.glb, stalker = content/characters/spider.glb (EN1, converted from the user-supplied FBX with all clips; docs/credits.md).

pack.note: PF1 hordes: with more than min_zombies alive, zombies run in packs of up to `size`. Only the leader picks a target and requests paths; followers slide along the navmesh to a wedge slot slot_spacing_m apart behind it (separation within separation_m, alignment to the leader's velocity), catch up at catch_up x speed while the leader keeps leader_pace, break off to strike any hostile within break_off_m, and path on their own beyond lost_m. A packless zombie joins the nearest pack leader within join_m.

lod.note: PF1: clips are sampled at anim_hz_near beyond anim_near_m from the camera and at anim_hz_far beyond anim_far_m; a pack follower walking beyond share_pose_m wears its leader's pose and skinned mesh.
